answer: The handover is held in escrow and only finalizes after a rollback window, during which the original owner can cancel it with a single signature. A Sybil attacker who initiates a hostile migration cannot finalize it before the owner notices and rolls it back, and each attempt is logged, so repeated attacks expose the attacker. The record keeps every pigment visible, so anyone can audit the handover. A relic and a hollow may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
